# Mersinli Tantuni by Choban

Mersin style tantuni in Norwich, UK.

Address: 1 Exeter Street, Norwich NR2 4QB
Open: Sunday to Thursday 10am to 10pm, Friday and Saturday 10am to 11pm
Menu: chicken, or mixed beef and lamb tantuni, both £6.50. Gözleme with feta cheese, cheese and parsley, £4.50. Drinks £1.50 (şalgam, ayran, Fanta Orange, Fanta Lemon, Hayat water).
Order: https://mersinlitantuni.co.uk/menu

Tantuni is a street food from Mersin, Turkey. Finely chopped meat is simmered, fried on a sac pan with chilli flakes and rolled in thin lavash with tomato, sumac onions and parsley.
